package.name: imu_bridge
package.description: Calibrated, car-axis IMU topics from the VESC IMU and an optional BNO085, a fused forward speed (/odom/fused) and the measured steering angle (/steering/measured), plus a shadow-mode robot_localization EKF config. Support code: publishes only sensor_msgs/Imu, sensor_msgs/JointState and copies of /odom; never /drive, /ackermann_cmd or /commands/*, so it cannot move the car.
